summary: Adds a guard returning self when the right-hand operand equals zero, correctly fixing sum()/0+Vector addition; matches a previously commented-out fix in the same file and is minimal and safe.

issues.description: Using `other == 0` before type-checking could raise/behave oddly for exotic right-hand operands whose __eq__ doesn't tolerate comparison to int 0, though this is consistent with existing sympy idioms.
